main.description: Create or update the site configuration for a repository owned by the authenticated user. Writing the config schedules a deploy attempt; the deploy outcome is recorded in history. If the deploy service is disabled, the config is saved but WorkerUnavailable is returned.

repoDid.description: DID of the repository as minted by the knot.

name.description: Repository name as its knot reports it (the first path segment its sub-path site is served under).

rkey.description: Atproto record key of the repository; identifies the {did}/{rkey}/ prefix in R2.

knot.description: Knot host that hosts the repository.

dir.description: Directory within the repository to deploy (e.g. '/' or '/docs').

isIndex.description: Whether this repo should serve as the index (root) for the claimed domain.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.description: The account is not the publisher of this repository's record.

errors.name: RepoNotFound
errors.description: No repository record publishes this repo DID.

errors.name: OwnershipUnverifiable
errors.description: Repository ownership could not be verified; the config was not saved.

errors.name: RepoIdentityMismatch
errors.description: The request's repository name, key or knot does not match its record.

errors.name: NoDomainClaim
errors.description: The account does not have an active domain claim.

errors.name: HandleNotOwned
errors.description: The handle authority identifies a different account.

errors.name: HandleUnknown
errors.description: The handle authority does not know this handle.

errors.name: ClaimUnverifiable
errors.description: The handle authority could not be reached to verify this claim.

errors.name: InvalidDirectory
errors.description: The deploy directory path is invalid.

errors.name: IndexSiteTaken
errors.description: Another repository is already the index site of the account's domain.

errors.name: WorkerUnavailable
errors.description: The config was saved but the deploy service is disabled.
